offers_products.reason: No goods or software sold; buys defaulted receivable portfolios as investments, not as a product offering.

offers_services.reason: Specialty finance: debt collection, debt servicing and portfolio management services for credit originators.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Consumers who owe debts are counterparties, repaying through payment plans; consumer-facing collections are central.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Banks, credit unions, utilities and retailers sell portfolios and buy servicing and portfolio management services.

recurring_revenue.reason: Ongoing payments from consumers repaying purchased debt over time, plus repeat portfolio and servicing relationships with banks.

cyclical_demand.reason: Collections and debt purchasing continue in downturns; defaulted-debt supply typically rises, so demand isn't postponable.

big_ticket.reason: Debt portfolio purchases are large, but its consumers make small, frequent repayments; main activity is collections.

people_delivered.reason: Value comes from purchased receivable portfolios and analytics models, not mainly staff time; collectors support recovery.

large_customers.reason: Portfolios bought from major banks, credit unions and utility providers; sellers are large financial institutions.

asset_heavy.reason: Buys receivable portfolios and runs call-center collections; needs capital for purchases but not plants, fleets or networks.

notes: Revenue mostly comes from collecting on purchased defaulted debt from consumers; classification of buyer is a judgment call.
